provenance: Owner supplied backpack.zip, handheld-portable-radio-walkie-talkie.zip, earth-terra-downloadable-model.zip, used-binoculars.zip and sony-walkman-wmd-dt1-evangelion-ver.zip and requested their integration. Original creator/licence metadata was not included in the model archives; original rights are retained. No new licence or CC0 status is claimed.

backpack.placement: Port bench, rotated 180 degrees from the previous release so the front faces the player. Same size and measured support contact.
backpack.conversion: Reduced from approximately 237,000 triangles; rebuilt vertex normals, preserved authored colour/normal/PBR maps, 1K WebP textures.
backpack.interaction: 3D inspection, rotation/zoom and packing/unpacking radio, Walkman and binoculars. Packing is stored with this voyage; no unsupported zipper/open-bag mesh animation is claimed.

radio.placement: Face-up on starboard bench, clear of oar handles. Click opens the shared 3D inspector and existing live station controls; R also opens this view.
radio.conversion: FBX world transforms baked, glTF UV V convention corrected, one combined mesh and 1K base/normal/packed roughness-metal maps.

earth.usage: Supplied colour and cloud maps on the existing geographic sphere so longitude/latitude orientation stays correct. Cloud layer fades during descent. Blender file was not executed.

walkman.conversion: Original body/cassette geometry and colour, OpenGL normal, AO, roughness, metalness and opacity retained. 2K body colour, other textures 1K/512. Omitted the detached extended earphone lead from the stowed model for bench/oar clearance. Original source archive untouched.
walkman.interaction: Spotify embed/API, custom playlist or album, power and true playback/time display on an atlas-fitted overlay on the original LCD. Preview/full playback depends on Spotify and the listener session.
walkman.placement: Face-up beside the radio on the broad transverse bench, inward of the starboard rowlock; no longer beneath the forward edge of the bench.

binoculars.conversion: Reduced from 204,544 triangles; original authored colour/normal/AO, separate lens material. Ignored the MTL diffuse slot pointing at its specular map; used the supplied colour image.
binoculars.interaction: Inspectable model; 3–8× optical camera projection of the live world, pointer/touch panning, magnification slider and wheel, Escape/Lower to restore the normal camera.

inspection.controls: Click an onboard item or Equipment/I; drag to rotate; wheel/pinch to zoom; Front/Back/Reset; item controls; Put down/Escape.
inspection.reference: Interaction pattern informed by the user’s Object Room. Pacific Drift uses its own viewer and asset models.
inspection.isolation: Inspection uses cloned materials/transforms and a neutral studio light. The boat remains in real time; input to rowing/steering is suspended during inspection and binocular use.

validation.tests: 21 scripts, including metre dimensions, pairwise prop clearance, hull support, atlas-fitted LCD, true playback states, optical magnification and sprite-free picking.
validation.browser: Backpack direct click, model drag rotation, kit pack/unpack, live Ukhozi FM On Air, Spotify preview playback and LCD clock, working lantern switch, 4–8× live binocular zoom/pan/lower, 390px inspection layout.
validation.limitations: Physical-phone GPU performance not measured; Spotify listening availability is controlled by Spotify. Source backpack is static; no working zipper mesh animation.

gps.author: dengxiart (https://sketchfab.com/dengxiart)
gps.derivative: Original emitter screenshot removed. 1K authored PBR maps; live chart mapped to actual glass.

anbernic.source: Owner Object Room RG35XX (2024) and original Pocket Garden game
anbernic.derivative: Transparent shell and internals, optimized 1K maps, independent live LCD; garden progress saved with voyage.
